name: unpaged-codex
description: Create visual Unpaged plans and review anchored feedback in the same Codex task with explicit human acceptance.

interface.shortDescription: Create and review visual plans in Codex.
interface.longDescription: Create a visual plan, receive board comments in its assigned Codex task, and revise until the owner explicitly accepts the current plan. Includes durable local delivery state and visible recovery limits.
defaultPrompt: Turn our plan into an Unpaged visual plan and listen for review comments.
Review the new feedback on our Unpaged plan.
